title: Detached local style — styles-map id is NOT mirrored into the element's classes (R4/§5.1)
_comment: Seed bootstrap INVALID fixture (WP-F06, 14-fixtures-harness.md §1 trees/v4/invalid, §4). All props are correctly-typed envelopes (so the tree passes element-node/style-variant schema validation), but the local-style id `e-hd00005-cc33dd4` is present in the `styles` map yet ABSENT from settings.classes.value — the style would silently DETACH and never render (11-authoring-contract.md §5.1, R4). This is the ONE structural rule the TS pre-filter decides authoritatively (checkR4 → LOCAL_STYLE_UNLINKED), so prefilter.verdict:reject and the meta-invariant reject⇒expect.valid:false holds. The companion validator also surfaces LOCAL_STYLE_UNLINKED.
